# Rules ledger — every firm rule this stage relies on

One row per rule. **Nothing in this repository may depend on a rule whose status is not `verified`.**
`propedge/contract/rules.py` loads its values from [`config/rules.yaml`](config/rules.yaml), the machine-readable
copy of this table, and **raises** if code asks for a rule that is not marked verified. That is the enforcement;
this file is the human-readable record behind it.

The **`key`** column is the `config/rules.yaml` key, so the two files can be compared mechanically.
`tests/test_rules_ledger_agreement.py` checks them **value by value** — key, value, status, article id and date
read — and fails if either file drifts from the other. Every row below is 1:1 with a yaml key; behavioural rules
that carry no configurable parameter are listed separately in §C.

## Status vocabulary

| status (this file) | `config/rules.yaml` | meaning | may code use it? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verified` | `verified` | Read on the **official** Topstep help centre (help.topstep.com) or topstep.com, with the article id, URL and date recorded below and the exact quoted text in the yaml note | yes |
| `carried from stage one — RE-VERIFY` | `carried_from_stage_one_reverify` | Stage one verified it on 2026-09-20/21 and this stage depends on it, but it has not been re-read in stage two. Rules change; a year-old reading is a lead, not a verification | **no** |
| `UNVERIFIED — HUMAN INPUT REQUIRED` | `unverified_human_input_required` | Needed by stage two, never verified by either stage | **no** |
| `third-party` | `third_party` | Sourced from a non-official page. **Never sufficient.** Recorded so the question is not lost | **no** |

Update a row with `/verify-rule <rule>`, which invokes the **rules-verifier** agent: it fetches the official
article, quotes the exact text, writes the value, article id, URL and today's date into both this file and
`config/rules.yaml`, and appends a `DECISIONS.md` entry. It never marks a rule verified from a third-party source.

> **Values are written in canonical form** (the number the code loads), with the human reading in brackets after
> it. That is deliberate: a `value` column that said only "90 / 10" could not be checked against `0.9`.

---

## A. Verified — read on the official help centre in T1, 2026-09-22

76 of 78 rules as of 2026-11-14 (the two not verified are in §B). Read by the **rules-verifier** agent, each quote fetched two to
four times with differently-worded prompts; the load-bearing ones were independently spot-checked in
the session. Full quotes are in the `note` of each key in [`config/rules.yaml`](config/rules.yaml).

Two rows were re-read on 2026-09-27 (T11). Each page's raw HTML was fetched twice, with identical text both
times, and quoted from the article body rather than through a summarising tool. The two rows are
`scaling_tier_after_payout`, now page-verified on 8284233, and `responsible_trading_program`, whose note now
states the scope of the RTP daily loss limit. The behavioural rules read the same day are in §C.

One row was re-read on 2026-10-01: `responsible_trading_program`. The page had been edited since 2026-09-27. Its note
now records how the program ends (only through a Live Funded Account, which closes every XFA) and that placement
follows a Risk Team review (D-219).

Thirteen rows were re-read on 2026-10-03 for the next stage's contract-fit and execution checks (D-247):
`combine_position_size_limit`, `funded_scaling_entry_tier_minis`, `funded_scaling_plan` (from the chart the page
embeds, viewed directly), `scaling_tier_after_payout`, `permitted_products`, `cross_account_hedging`,
`multi_account_same_strategy`, `max_active_funded_accounts`, `combine_consistency_max_day_frac`,
`xfa_cons_max_day_frac`, `xfa_cons_min_days`, `xfa_std_winning_days` and `xfa_std_winning_day_min`. **Every value
is unchanged.** New to the record: 8284206 says *"Avoid opening new positions after 3:08 PM CT — Risk Managers
begin flattening at that time."* (§C). 8284233 and 10296582 show "Updated this week"; the passages read from them
are unchanged, but the other rows that cite them were not re-read.

On 2026-10-25 three questions from P-09's audit (F1, F3) were read on the help centre (D-444, D-445, D-446). One new
row is verified here: `payout_after_request_survives_mll_breach` (8284233: *"Will I still get my Payout if I hit the
MLL after requesting?"* — *"Yes. Once the Payout amount has been deducted from your balance, hitting the MLL won't
affect it."*). The other two answers are silent or partial and sit in §B: `xfa_closure_at_request` (re-read) and the
new `xfa_seat_frees_at`. The processing times on 8284233 read the same day are unchanged; the two lag rows were not
re-dated.

On 2026-10-30, for D-490 (4) and D-494 (the leading candidates' money comes from bold funded play into the MLL and
from repurchasing Combines across five rotating seats), the conduct and closure pages were re-read on the help centre
and topstep.com's Terms of Use. **No loadable value changed.** One row is new: `focused_trader_program` (10551016),
whose Slowdown Path names "Excessive Resets and Trading Combine purchases" and "Activating and losing many Express
Funded Accounts in a short period of time" and whose Corrective Path names "Excessive recycling of Trading Combines®
or XFAs" -- none with a threshold -- with consequences heavier than tier 3's per-payout pricing (purchases stopped, one
account at a time; or every account closed and "Any pending payouts are denied"). Re-read and re-dated, values
unchanged: `combine_count_limit` (no mechanical limit, but the rate is named conduct), `prohibited_trading_strategies`,
`prohibited_conduct`, `responsible_trading_program` (edited again after 2026-10-01; the triggers and consequences
unchanged; 10406542 lists "Use MLL as a stop loss" as a Don't), `cross_account_hedging`,
`cross_account_opposite_positions` and `payout_after_request_survives_mll_breach`. The two §B rows were re-read and
stay unverified.

On 2026-11-14 the 28 rows last read on 2026-09-22 or 2026-10-03 that cite the payout policy (8284233), the Maximum
Loss Limit (8284204), consistency (8284208) and the price and billing pages (14289835, 8284121, 8284217) were re-read.
**No value changed.** Re-dated, values unchanged: `combine_profit_target`, `combine_mll`,
`combine_consistency_max_day_frac`, `combine_mll_lock_at`, `xfa_mll_start`, `xfa_lock_at`, `xfa_std_winning_days`,
`xfa_std_winning_day_min`, `xfa_std_cap`, `xfa_cons_min_days`, `xfa_cons_max_day_frac`, `xfa_cons_cap`, `payout_min`,
`payout_max_frac_of_balance`, `profit_split`, `require_profit_since_payout`, `subscription_fee`, `billing_days`,
`billing_period_calendar_days`, `activation_fee`, `reset_fee`, `payout_fee`, `hold_queue_behaviour`,
`payout_methods_and_fees`, `payout_lag_days_aeropay`, `payout_lag_days_ach`, `payout_fee_ach` and
`dll_offer_status`. Three wordings on 8284233 differ from the earlier quotes with no change of rule (*"Stay at or
below the 40% Consistency Objective."*, *"90/10 profit split — you keep 90%"*, *"Max Payout per request: 50% of your
account balance up to the cap below."*). 8284233 and 8284121 both show "Updated this week"; what those edits changed
was not identified, and every passage these rows rest on reads the same. New to the record: the cap-doubling offer's
start (*"Available starting at 3:30 PM CT on Tuesday, June 2nd."*), still with no end date; the Daily Loss Limit can
also be added at an XFA activation or reactivation and by hand in Risk Settings, none of which unlocks the higher cap
(10490293, 8284233); and a Responsible Trading Discount for a DLL added at purchase on a No Activation Fee Combine
($10 / $20 / $30 a month off by size, 14289835), on which 14289835 and 10490293 list different products.
**The Terms of Use on topstep.com now show "Last updated: November 4, 2026"** (September 21, 2026 when read on
2026-10-30); the rows that quote its sections 3, 8 and 27 (`prohibited_conduct`, `combine_count_limit`,
`xfa_closure_at_request`, `cross_account_opposite_positions`) have not been re-read against the new version.

Twenty-eight rows are new on 2026-11-14, all read that day: `xfa_payout_path_choice` (chosen by the trader at
activation, fixed afterwards; the only stated restriction is a Responsible Trading Program placement);
`xfa_cap_shared_across_sizes`; the 100K and 150K values of the profit target, Maximum Loss Limit, funded MLL start,
Combine position limit, subscription, reset and activation prices, scaling plan and both payout caps (keys suffixed
`_100k` and `_150k`; the unsuffixed keys stay the 50K values); `dll_amount_50k`, `dll_amount_100k`, `dll_amount_150k`;
`trading_hours` (with the holiday rule from 13350348); `account_start_rate_limit` (no page states one) and
`reset_limit_per_account_per_calendar_day`. Not stated on any page read, and so not rows: the balance at which a 100K
or 150K XFA's MLL locks at $0, and an activation fee labelled by size (the $149 is stated once for all sizes).

### Rows that need reading carefully

**`billing_days` is in TRADING days** because that is the engine's index;
`billing_period_calendar_days` carries the official 30-calendar-day figure. Conflating them caused a
real error — see D-29.

**The scaling plan is verified in full.** The 50K ladder (`funded_scaling_plan`: below $1,500 → 2 lots,
$1,500–$2,000 → 3, above $2,000 → 5) was read from the chart image on 8284223. The screenshot is saved at
`docs/evidence/8284223_scaling_plan_2026-09-22.png` (D-32), after D-31 withdrew the unsourced D-28 thresholds.
The entry tier also rests on the article's own textual example, *"$50K XFA, 2-lot Scaling Plan: 2 Minis, OR 20
Micros, OR Any combo equal to 2 Minis"*. The fall in tier after a payout (`scaling_tier_after_payout`) is stated in
text on 8284233 (re-read 2026-09-27): *"If a Payout reduces your balance to a lower tier, your maximum contract
size decreases accordingly."*

**The Combine and the XFA lock their days at different times.** A Combine day locks at 3:10 PM CT (8284208) and an
XFA day at 4:00 PM CT (8284233); see §C.
